newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: SOCCER-BOLIVIA HELD TO DRAW BY ALSO-RANS VENEZUELA.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOLIVIA HELD TO DRAW BY ALSO-RANS VENEZUELA.

text.p: Bolivia dropped two valuable World Cup qualifying points when they were held to a 1- 1 draw away to also-rans Venezuela on Sunday.

Venezuela, the only team in the group with no chance of qualifying, had taken only one point from their previous ten games and Bolivia had been counting on three points to keep their campaign on the rails.
Giovanni Savarese gave Venezuela a shock lead in the 63rd minute against at team who had beaten them 7-1 on their last visit four years ago.
Ten minutes later, Ramiro Castillo outpaced the Venezuela defence to a through ball by midfielder Milton Coimbra and equalised.
Castillo, Bolivia's best player, blotted his copybook, however, when he was sent off five minutes from the end for punching an opponent.
Bolivia, who have drawn half of their games, have 14 points from ten games but only one of their remaining six matches are at home.
